Move HEAD and reset both Index and Working Tree to the target commit.
Local tracked changes after the target commit are discarded.
This is a destructive operation.

Only non-conflicting local changes are preserved.
If conflicts are detected, reset aborts to protect your work.

ClassifierSettings.title: Session classification
ClassifierSettings.description: TypeSafe Jev reads expert sessions and keeps only what the next Agent would get wrong without, or what you would otherwise repeat: your corrections and preferences, pitfalls with a cause, and long-term decisions you approved. They are appended to 「记录/」 in the knowledge base as leads for curating it. Process already in the session (approach, progress) is not kept. Each session also gets a handoff (「交接/expert-name/」: what was asked, what got done, what is pending, commits in the meantime) that Agents read when they need it. Every write is listed under 「Memory → Jev activity」, where you can undo it or change its category. When on, the content of Agent sessions in Berth terminals is sent to TypeSafe; sessions without an expert only get a handoff. 「Jev classify」 on a session page works regardless of this switch.
ClassifierSettings.invalid: Fix the file and reopen this page. {error}
ClassifierSettings.categories: What to record (Jev scores each round against these)
ClassifierSettings.enablePrompt: Automatic classification is off. When on, Agent sessions in Berth terminals are sent to TypeSafe Jev, and hits and handoffs are written straight to files.
ClassifierSettings.decisionModel: The decision model is set under 「Model providers」: open a model's decision panel on a decision profile and click 「Use as Berth's decision model」. Without one, the first decision profile is used.
ClassifierSettings.fileHint: Questions, criteria and thresholds are the prompts Jev receives; the defaults come from testing on real sessions. To tune them, edit classifier.json. What Jev answered for each round is under 「Memory → Jev activity → Calls」.
